description: Create a free partner account so you earn a share of the commission on bookings made by people you send to TableJourney (see partner terms at /partners/terms/). No inbox? Leave email out: the answer holds your API key and referral code at once (add an email with partner_add_email before your first payout). With an email we send a one-time code; pass it to partner_confirm. accept_terms must be true. The person or company running the agent is the member and the payee.

email.description: Optional: an inbox you or your operator can read. Leave out to join without one.
